m1.typescript: m1 a mixed set of sessions gets every rate and the first fix

e1.typescript: e1 no sessions give zero rates and no diagnosis

e2.typescript: e2 a protected call before a successful identity check is a skipped prerequisite

e3.typescript: e3 a refund over the limit counts only when it was made

e4.typescript: e4 money first then tool descriptions then escalation criteria

e5.typescript: e5 the target boundary and rounding of the first contact rate

e6.typescript: e6 a wrong tool counts sessions and ignores steps with no known right tool

wrong-failed-identity-opens.defect: treats a failed identity check as an identification

wrong-over-limit-any-outcome.defect: counts a refund over the limit in a session where it was refused and escalated

wrong-diagnosis-criteria-first.defect: puts the escalation criteria before the tool descriptions in the order of fixes

wrong-target-strict.defect: requires the rate to be above the target and not at it

wrong-wrong-tool-steps.defect: counts wrong steps and not the sessions that have one

wrong-empty-rate-one.defect: reports a rate of 1 when there are no sessions

wrong-over-counts-needs-human.defect: counts every escalation as an over-escalation, even one that needed a person
